# Knight First Amendment Institute

> A leading nonprofit organization advancing First Amendment rights, digital freedoms, and press freedom through litigation, research, and policy advocacy.

Based at Columbia University, the Knight First Amendment Institute combines legal action with scholarly research to defend free speech, combat surveillance, promote government transparency, and shape AI governance. The institute engages with pressing issues at the intersection of technology, democracy, and constitutional rights.

## Key Topics

- First Amendment
- Free Speech
- Press Freedom
- Digital Rights
- Surveillance
- Social Media Regulation
- Content Moderation
- Section 230
- AI Governance
- Government Accountability
- Geofence Warrants
- Litigation
- Government Transparency
- Chilling Effects
- Free Expression

## Core Issues & Advocacy

- [Free Speech & Social Media](https://knightcolumbia.org/issues/free-speech-social-media): Examining platform regulation and content moderation challenges in the digital age
- [Privacy & Surveillance](https://knightcolumbia.org/issues/privacy-surveillance): Addressing digital rights, geofence warrants, and data governance issues
- [Transparency & Democracy](https://knightcolumbia.org/issues/transparency-democracy): Advancing press freedom, Section 230 reform, and government accountability

## Litigation & Legal Work

- [Litigation](https://knightcolumbia.org/litigation): First Amendment cases, amicus briefs, and constitutional law challenges

## Research & Policy

- [Research](https://knightcolumbia.org/research): First Amendment studies, AI governance, and democratic freedoms research
- [Policy](https://knightcolumbia.org/policy): Platform accountability, social media regulation, and AI governance initiatives

- [About the Knight Institute](https://knightcolumbia.org/page/about-the-knight-institute): Mission and overview of Knight Institute's First Amendment and digital rights work
